title: Operator-mode offline bootstrap + upgrade rollback preview assets
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design a compact set of UX assets for the Private/VPC onboarding path focused on operator-driven, air-gapped installs and safe upgrades. Deliverables: (1) a step-by-step visual flow for zero-touch offline bootstrap (operator CLI + console pairing), (2) console screen mocks for preflight checks and cryptographic key import, (3) a compact upgrade preview diff UI that visualizes schema changes, preflight warnings, and a rollback timeline, and (4) annotated screenshots and export-ready assets for release notes and docs. Assets should support both light/dark themes and include accessible color contrast and terse microcopy for operators.
acceptance_criteria: A set of 6 high-fidelity console mocks (PNG + Figma) covering: bootstrap start, connectivity validation, key/certificate import, install progress, upgrade preview diff, rollback timeline
A 1-page onboarding flow SVG and a vertical stepper illustration for the docs quickstart
Microcopy reviewed and signed off by PM and Eng for technical accuracy
Export-ready annotated screenshots (1920x1080) for release notes and a compact 600x400 hero image for the quickstart
Accessibility check: contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for body text and >= 3:1 for UI affordances
comments: 2026-02-22 - Ava Martinez: Kickoff meeting with PM (Maya Patel) and Eng (Ravi Kapoor). Agreed scope: include offline root CA import modal and a non-blocking 'skip network checks' path for advanced operators.

2026-02-26 - Leo Chen: Initial wireframes uploaded to Figma. Highlights: condensed stepper + inline CLI command copy box. Flagged need for exact log lines from runtime team for install progress state.
2026-03-01 - Ravi Kapoor (eng): Provided sample preflight check outputs and edge cases for unreachable KMS endpoints. Requested a prominent warning state and clear recovery CTA.

2026-03-04 - Usability testing: 3 infra engineers completed the flow in lab; feedback: (a) rollback timeline needs clarity on data retention windows, (b) prefer a single 'dry-run' button for upgrades. Updating mocks.
2026-03-07 - Leo Chen: High-fidelity mocks complete. Ready for PM review. Next: accessibility pass and annotate images for docs team.
